records.name: Agrix Tech
records.description: Every season, about 40% of small-scale farmers in Africa are not able to make a profit from their investment due to crop diseases and poor farming practices, most of which come from their lack of adequate farming knowledge because they are self-taught farmers with very little access to knowledge. Thanks to our AI based platform, Agrix Tech delivers an accessible and profession- al advisory service to farmers so they can make their farming projects profitable. – We help them to choose the right crops for their specific soil type. – We help them to properly monitor the healthy growth of their crops. – And we help them to control crop diseases and pests whenever their farm is attacked. As result, we remove the uncertainty and high stress that these farmers have because for most, this is their only source of revenue. Cameroon Adamou Kouotou

records.name: Agrodata
records.description: Agrodata optimizes farmlands with the iSmartHive to use honey bees as pollinators for fruit and vegetable farming. The proprietary iSmartHive is an IoT device that is placed in farmlands to offer pollination as a service. Agrodata has pre-deployed 5,000 which collates agro-ecological data from farmlands and analyses this to improve the crop-soil ecosystem. Agrodata has additionally mapped honey-bees using Earth Observation Tech creating the Community Bee-Agrifood Network (CoBAN). A bee-centered crops model in which iSmartHives are installed for free on smallholder farms. Received a donation for the fabrication and installation of 200 iSmarthives Has received orders for more than 10,000 iSmartHives.

records.name: AGS Tribe / Herconomy
records.description: AGS Tribe is a platform that connects women to each other and to economic opportunities such as grants, loans, jobs, scholarships etc. We also offer capacity building, networking and an affinity network where members of our community save money by getting up to 30% off from over 60 brands (and counting) within our network. With over 14,000 members within our network, we are adding more value by transitioning to a fintech focus through Herconomy, a digital bank with a service offering that serves as an enabler for the success of our members. We will empower women with not just savings accounts which will yield them guaranteed high interests on their saving, they will also save as they spend on products and services women need on a day to day. Since our launch, we have trained and empowered over 80 thousand women online and offline through capacity building, funding and men- torship. AGS Tribe/Herconomy Nigeria Ifedayo Durosinmi-Etti

records.name: Chekkit Technologies
records.description: Chekkit technologies was founded in 2018 and is currently based out of Lagos, Nigeria with incorporation as well in the United States. Our goal has always been to develop cutting edge technology solutions for the consumer goods and pharmaceutical industries which will help guaran- tee the integrity of products as well as safeguard the lives of consumers. Our solutions are deployed on a blockchain network for security and transparency and we provide product authentication technology to producers that spans across Anti-Counterfeiting, Consumer Rewards, Consumer Engagement and Market Data/Insights. Our vision is that one day, Chekkit's labels will be the seal of genuity for every great product, ensuring we know the story of everything we consume. We believe that in a few years, Chekkit's platform will become the leading product authentication and distribution tracking technology in the world with millions of lives impacted. Nigeria Dare Odumade Tosin Adelowo

records.name: Dawa Health
records.description: At Dawa Health, we have created a digital health platform empowering mothers to receive remote maternal health. The DawaMom platform is a multi-lingual, AI-powered, digital health platform accessible via a smartphone app, SMS app, web portal, and a text/audio chat-bot. The platform provides expectant mothers with tailored weekly maternal advice to help them identify pathological changes in time. Women on Sayana Press self-in- jectable kits can get 24/7 digital support over the DawaMom platform. Also, the DawaMom platform works together with a network of safe motherhood action group (SMAG) agents who provide bi-monthly visits to pregnant mothers and quarterly visits to mothers on Sayana Press kits. We provide a DawaMom kit to SMAGs that they use to support mothers remotely over the platform. The data wire from the network of SMAGs is then interpreted by qualified health professionals remotely to provide remote insights. Zimbabwe Tafadzwa Kalisto Munzwa Progress Mahureva

records.name: Motito
records.description: Africa is notably a cash-based economy where credit cards are not effective. Financial institutions such as banks focus mainly on lending to corporate clients due to the lack of credit history data needed to operationalize consumer finance, this leaves over 100m people needing financial assistance and a lending gap of over $91b on the African continent. Consumers are getting more sophisticated (needing alternative modes of payment) and financial institutions are looking to expand more rapidly into consumer finance but need help from startups to do so. Motito is promoting financial inclusion and increased access to credit across Africa. We do this via a buy now, pay later platform that enables small businesses to offer an interest-free credit option to their existing customers at point-of-sale. Similar to a credit card, with Motito you can walk into a merchant store (e.g. Samsung store) and make payment in installments for items you purchase. Ghana Tobi Martins

records.name: Nucleus IS
records.description: Health Insurance is arguably the only way the middle and lower class of any economy can afford quality healthcare. However in Africa the industry is constrained by identity fraud, data, cost efficiency and technology. These have led to low adoption of health insurance across the continent, In Nigeria for instance, only about 5 million people out of a population of about 200 million are enrolled for health insurance. This is directly responsible for abysmal health indices that includes high child mortality rate, disease preva- lence to low life expectancy among others. We have built technology that curtails fraud, reduces cost, increases efficien- cy and provide distribution channels for sales. We have built to connect all stakeholders as we believe an ecosystem approach is the best way to radically improve the number of insured lives and improve health outcomes in Africa. Our solution provides a single aggregated platform for care and distribution to drive interoperability and efficiency. Nigeria Olukayode Odeyinde

records.name: Thumeza
records.description: Inaccessible working capital to service post-paid loads is a problem being faced by 80% of small scale transporters active in Africa's 300 billion USD logistics industry. As they lack collateral or credible operational data, they are unable to get access to credit from formal institutions limiting their ability to service clients. Thumeza's solution is an online platform providing immediately accessible working capital based on, on-platform and off-platform transport- er operational activities. Our key advantage is our ability to tap into the back end of large enterprises 3rd party transporter networks, directly servicing their transporters working capital needs while they wait to get paid. This ensures that Thumeza is able to work with transporters who have existing relationships with shippers, guaranteeing payment. Zimbabwe Gugulethu Siso

records.name: Ustacky
records.description: We are teaching industry relevant technology skills to Africans here by making them employable all over the world. We do this by providing quality video content, quizzes & projects to aid the student learning. Our video content is rich & immersive with relevant illustration for Africans. We have assignments and code reviews to guide the students and there are dedicated mentors to guide students all through the program. We are producing employable Africans at large scale. With only over a month of starting operations, over 2500 Africans have registered on the program and we have received dozens of great reviews. Nigeria Ilyas Soladogun Ibrahim Mudathir

records.name: Weza Ventures
records.description: A large proportion of the population in Africa is denied access to credit facilities due to lack of a dependable credit scoring mechanism. The available credit scoring mechanisms in the African continent focus only on the data from traditional banking industry, ignoring the vast valuable data from the mobile phones that could be used to generate a dependable credit score. We are building the new age tools in credit scoring and fraud mitigation to power new models of lending such as using mobile phone data to score a user’s credit worthiness. We employ machine learning algorithms (Artificial Intelli- gence) that uses the data available on customers’ cellphones to predict the credit worthiness. Our core focus is providing underlying technology to enable financiers, and retail merchants to offer their goods and services on credit to the people in the informal sector. Kenya Samuel Njuguna Kevin Bwisa

records.name: Worldbay Technologies / Grocedy
records.description: Our solution is taking the principle of crowd-funding and thrift, applying it to food. Simply put, cheaper prices for our subscribers by encouraging and enabling saving toward their staple food needs. We have created a means by which low-income earners can purchase the food items they need in small volumes/quantities but at wholesaler prices, through a monthly subscription model. Each subscription tier contains a bouquet of staple foods in varying quantities. We only cater for the staple foods like rice, beans, cassava granules (garri), vegetable oils, semo, milk, yam flour, wheat, pepper, salt etc. leveraging economies of scale to drive prices lower for our subscribers. We make it easier and convenient for our monthly subscribers to pay what they can afford to pay (a minimum of the equivalent of 50cents) over a 27-day period, which allows them to save toward their food plan as they earn. By pooling their subscription payments together, we can purchase these food items at significantly reduced prices from our vendors/farmers, repackage them in our main warehouse, transport them to our delivery hubs and deliver to our customers once a month through a last mile, uber-like pick-up and delivery mobile application that allows any approved van owner/driver to do our last mile delivery from the delivery hubs to the customer. We have found that the lower income earners prefer this savings methodology and allows them to obtain their staples much cheaper. Worldbay Technologies Nigeria Olanrewaju Smith

records.name: Crowdyvest
records.description: Won the best Series A award at the AfricArena summit Nominated as a finalist for the FinTech of the year award by the African Banker Magazine Crowdyvest is an impact-driven financial technology platform that p r ov i d e s fi n a n c i a l s o l u t i o n s f o r communities and organizations that are committed to long-term growth and financial freedom. Our objective is to put money to work, and achieving the best possible returns while making an impact. Since 2020, we have developed a range of products and services in pursuit of this goal, from simple savings accounts to funding impact projects with sustainable returns. The mobile app and web platform allows access to savings, investments, deals & offers, and vending & bill payments. With VestEngine, a robust API suite, we are confident to increase our network to 2 million users by 2024.

records.name: eCampus LLC
records.description: Outstanding Industry Leadership Award (EdTech) eCampus uses a digital platform to monitor educational performance that helps regulators and supervisors increase efficiency in learning. eCampus’ platform is AI and ML enabled to generated real time analytical reports on the learning progress of students in various subjects. With that, eCampus offers an intelligent tool for planning and succeeding at exams, job interviews, and in educational compliance. Aiming at making education as ef ficient and as effective as possible, eCampus offers solutions for every stakeholder involved. Education Startup of the Year

records.name: Ecomak Recyclers
records.description: Was selected to participate in the OceanHub Africa Acceleration Program 2022 The team was selected to join the Africa Summit 2022 Ecomak produces Eco-friendly housing materials from recycled plastic, at a price point that is 30% lower than conventional materials. Ecomak’s bricks are sustainable, long- lasting, require low maintenance, and use up 1 Kg of plastic waste per brick. The plastic bricks are twice as strong as conventional bricks while reducing pollution by households. To g e t h e r w i t h o u r m i c r o w a s t e insurance program for low-income households, people are able to smoothen t he i r c o n s u m p t i o n a n d re i nve s t additional income. So far, Ecomak has created 100 direct and indirect jobs engaged in plastic was collection.

records.name: Neural Labs Africa
records.description: UNICEF gave Neural Labs Africa an equity free grant of USD 50,000 Partnered with the Ministry of Health in Senegal and will start clinical trials in Dakar Neural Labs Africa Ltd. uses AI to transform medical imaging diagnosis in real time. We at Neural Labs Africa Innovation Hub have developed an algorithm that uses deep learning and computer vision to identify diseases, trademarked “NeuralSight”. It is able to label and highlight over 20 respiratory, heart, breast diseases & pathologies. Our ground breaking technology has gained traction from radiologists and hospitals within Africa and is a direct tool to reduce Africa’s disease burden, reduce medical workload, and improving patient care.

records.name: ParcSmart
records.description: Won the GITEX North Star Dubai Startup Pitch Competition In congested cities, people spend a lot of time looking for space to park their vehicles. ParcSmart has created a crowdsourcing solution for parking spaces in such cities. ParcSmart’s digital platform enables share d reservation for parking spaces that eases commuting. Users are able to reserve parking spaces via smartphone near their destination when traveling and post them when not in use. With vision to improve commuting and capitalizing on parking spaces in fast growing emerging markets, we are able to create solutions that are tailored to city specific needs. Selected for the Google For Startups #SDG Program

records.name: Powerstove Energy
records.description: Pitched at Lions Den, Nigeria and raised USD 96,000 Won the GSMA Innovation Fund Powerstove is a patented innovative IoT- enabled smokeless stove that reduces energy costs and CHG emissions. Together with the production of up- cycled wood pellets, Powerstove provides self-generated electricity that reduces the carbon footprint of each consumer. With its IoT system, Powerstove is able to track and send data remotely to a base server, which is able to generate Co2 credits. Powe r s tove’s g o a l i s to i nc re a s e t r a n s p a re nc y, a c c o u nt a b i l i t y a nd credibility in carbon offsetting projects, while bridging crucial infrastructural deficiencies.

records.name: Proxalys
records.description: Won the 1st prize of the Free au Senegal #Fix Challenge Won the 2nd prize at the GITEX North Star Dubai Startup pitch Competition Proxalys is a fresh produce supply chain company and B2B Commerce platform for FMCG products. We aim to connect f o o d p r o d u c e r s w i t h r e t a i l e r s , restaurants, and hospitality service providers, using in-house applications that drive end to end operations. Proxalys’ goal is to modernize and empower African retailers operating in the informal market, by digitizing their supply chain and management systems and offering credit solutions such as BNPL or factoring. With that, we are focused on the accessibility for the most fragmented parts of society and intend to leverage our strengths to innovate and solve complex supply chain problems for thousands of retailers and distributors.

records.name: Qataloog
records.description: Students are struggling to pay for textbooks, and prices continue to rise. This leaves students constrained and unable to attain the education they require to seek employment. Qataloog is an effective market-maker for academic literature for students at colleges and universities. It enables e duc ational outc omes and helps students to discover, share, acquire, and manage their learning progress and academic resources. Qataloog seeks to provide the latest findings from the best publishers, authors, and aggregators in Africa, Europe, America, and Asia to students in Africa through a content algorithm and data analytics. 38 universities and colleges as paying customers Onboarded 2,800+ academic publishers

records.name: Rural Farmers Hub
records.description: Rural Farmers Hub uses web- and mobile-based technology to increase agricultural productivity. Rural Farmers Hub is able to offer precise management of crop health & soil nutrients with cloud- based automated assessment. Our platform “Capture” creates intelligent maps to plan precise fixing of identi fied defects. With the help of our proprietary algorithm, we are able to process satellite images and climate data to generate real- time farming advice that is delivered to farmers by SMS, voice, apps, and in- person. Rural Farmers hub additionally provides agricultural inputs through third parties to increase yields and allow access to finance. Selected for Katapult Mauritius Accelerator Program Closed a pre-seed round of 500k USD in May 2022

records.name: Vooli Mobile Insurance
records.description: Vooli app uses valuation API technology to evaluate premiums for insurance companies and uses information processing to create the most cost effective and ef ficient insurance coverage. Vooli enables automation for registration, servicing, and claim settlement procedures that reduces fraud and human error. Vooli is able to offer multiple on demand insurance options that are flexible, have lowe r p re m i u m s , a nd e l i m i n a te fraudulent activity. The simpli fied signing process and app, allows the elimination of sales agents and an increase in responsive customer engagement. Got pre-qualified for 5 country government contracts starting August 2022 Onboarded 30 underwriting companies

records.name: BD Waste
records.description: BD Waste is a GreenTech startup focusing on recovering communities' waste. It combines fintech and sustainability to provide a recycling and financing system to it users. Customers can deposit their waste into a digital wallet and receive credit for it, which can be used to purchase various goods and services, including data packages, airtime, food, stationery, and health insurance. Every day, millions of tons of plastic waste are disposed of in landfills and water bodies, threatening marine and human life. We believe that by using plastic as a means of saving, we can help people who do not have access to bank accounts, particularly those living in slum communities and low/middle-income areas, start saving money. BD Waste is a GreenTech startup that combines fintech and sustainability to recover Plastic waste from communities. The company's Digicycle product allows customers to deposit plastic waste into their digital wallets and receive credit for it, which can be used to purchase various items. BD Waste collects and processes over 50 tons of plastic waste per month, and has been recognized by the World Economic Forum and the Africa Development Bank for its efforts to address plastic pollution and use technology to solve societal issues. records.name: CargoPlug
records.description: Cargoplug Cargoplug, a spinoff of Jand2Gidi, brings its B2C expertise of almost a decade to offer a simple shipping API that integrates into the checkout process and minimizes uncertainties and transit times of shipping to and within Africa. The company specializes in cross-border shipments, providing rapid transit times of as little as 24-48 hours from the UK to the African continent. Additionally, Cargoplug manages customs and logistics procedures, making it easy for customers to ship goods from around the world to Africa. In addition, we provide intuitive dashboards and incorporate secure plug-ins compatible with prominent international and domestic business platforms. This seamless integration ensures complete visibility of deliveries throughout the supply chain for businesses. Our comprehensive solution empowers local vendors to expand their market presence while enabling global brands to penetrate new markets. Since the pilot, they have onboarded a number of customers including VC-funded fintech, logitech and aggregators. They were also featured on CNN's Inside Africa in September 2022, as women leading the tech boom in West Africa.

records.name: Chestify AI
records.description: Chestify is addressing the shortage issue by providing a platform that remote- ly and quickly matches radiologists with patients from hospitals based on availability and specialism. and boost radiologists' productivity with an AI-powered DICOM reader. Our target customers include Hospitals, Lab test centers, Private Radiologists. Our platform enables Radiologists or clinicians to upload the chest x-ray image into our system and the Convolutional Neural Networks in our algo- rithm scampers the chest x-ray to point out abnormal patterns on the chest x-ray. All this is done under 3 minutes saving a significant amount of time, enhanc- ing productivity. Health facilities and medical practitioners who use our platform tend to have a 99.99% enhanced rate of accuracy in their workflow, fast diagnostic report- ing procedures with a 10 times increased productivity and evade operational drudgery and complexities using the platform.

records.name: Kyanda
records.description: Kyanda offers an interoperable wallet as a service to individuals and busi- nesses to enable them to digitally send and receive money, Pay their Bills, making payments and transactions seamless across the African continent. Our network of agents, API gateway, and various access channels such as USSD, Mobile App & Whatsapp Chatbots make it easy for you to use our services in a way that fits your needs. In addition to money transfers, we also offer a wide range of financial services such as utility bill payments, insurance, and more. With over 5.7 million serviced users in Kenya and South Africa over the years, we have a proven track record of delivering top-quality service to our customers. The services offered cut across Utility Bill Payments (offered to businesses through our powerful APIs) , Payment Collections and Disbursements to/from Mobile Money Wallets, Bank Accounts & Card Payments.

records.name: Limawa
records.description: Limawa designs and manufactures locally solar or hybrid-powered refrigeration units, which are suitable for various types of infrastructure. These solutions are an innovative, economical, and ecological alternative to the use of conventional compressors powered by electricity or fuel in the refrigeration industry. With this cutting-edge technology, we can ensure that every piece of product arrives fresh and ready for consumption, therefore reducing the amount of waste. We are committed to ensuring a better preservation of our customers' products, but also of our environment.

records.name: Moja Ride
records.description: Moja Ride helps transport operators, taxi and minibus drivers track their earning through a powerful and simple ticketing and payment solution.We offer a drive to own program to the most performing unbanked drivers. We reduce the risk of default through a combination of data driven underwriting and a prepaid model which allowed us a zero default rate since we launched over a year ago. We have made it our mission to enable better and cleaner mobility services to African cities by making financing easy and accessible for all transportation professionals. Drivers and transport companies can easily qualify for new car loans and car repairs by simply working with Moja Ride's advanced digital fare payment and booking technologies. We leverage the drivers' revenue and AI/machine learning to qualify them for car loans. Our solution is the first alternative financing solution for those who otherwise do not have access to financing which requires no down payment or collateral.

records.name: Parkwell
records.description: Parkwell matches drivers with available, safe parking spaces and helps property owners list their parking spaces for optimum use. We do this with our mobile and web applications. Digital Parking Platform that integrates parking facilities and connects it to mobile for a seamless experience. Essentially connecting all parking and mobility stakeholders on a common platform who were until now operating in silos. Parkwell is conceived with an ambitious view to digitize the global parking industry. Parking across the globe is becoming more inextricably linked with technology and automation, and parkers from developing countries present a new demographic of parkers who are ready to go digital. 2022 and beyond, there is no doubt that the industry will start to experience some enthusiastic growth and massive innovations to the parking needs of these countries. For Drivers: Too Much Road Hassles, it is really hard to get parking spaces around you or your destination not even to book ahead of time Car Safety is not assured as security is not guaranteed most times. For Car Parks: Low or No Patronage. Cause drivers don’t know where the parks are Revenue Leakage. it's really hard to stop the revenue leakage. Low Park Optimization. Car Parks can do much more than what they do Environment: Co2 Emissions with transport emissions accounting for over 40% of total fuel combustion.

records.name: PharmaServ
records.description: PharmaServ is an offline-capable sales workflow-support software that manages sales and medical detailing operations as well as front- and back-office activities of sales team in low-resource settings. Our unique selling proposition; is the Dynamic Discounting Algorithm feature which enables healthcare sales managers (and Field sales agents) to incentivize their customers with certain discounts on their purchase orders if they make instant payment (Pay Now), rather than paying later. More than 80% of healthcare sales orders (SO) in Sub-Saharan Africa are still made over phone calls and monitored manually. This has led to; Inaccuracy in orders, Delay in Delivery, Lots of paperwork, Fraud by the Field Sales Team, and Inordinate time processing orders. Ideal Customer Profile: Pharmaceutical Brands (Sales Team), Healthcare Consumer/Commodity Goods Brands (Sales Team), Diagnostic Brands (Sales Team), Surgical Equipment Brands (Sales Team). - We currently have 12 brand (pharmaceutical companies) - 300+ sales team members using our software - $7k MRR

records.name: SafeTrack (COGNX)
records.description: Safetrack provides affordable IoT solutions for African farmers. Our smart datalogger, collects and analyzes data from sensors, without internet , increasing productivity and reducing water usage. Our pilot project with Danone showed a 20% increase in productivity. we aim to capture 5% of the $480 million market in Africa by 2025 Morocco is poor in water resources. It takes more than 200 litres of water to produce a KG of tomatoes and Morocco is one of the world's leading exporters. Our technology allows a 75 % reduction in water consumption for irrigation at 20 % of the price of our competitors. Our IoT solution of geolocation and monitoring 100 % mobile, simple maintenance and which does not require any IT infrastructure. Composed of revalued smartphones and sensors and other affordable devices, and a cloud software platform developed internally. •/uni00A0Consumption •/uni00A0Reduce water and energy consumption, to reduce energy bills and prevent water and electricity shortages. •/uni00A0Productivity •/uni00A0Increase productivity related to ongoing soil depletion, through affordable soil testing •/uni00A0Diseases •/uni00A0Adopt a preventive approach to improve yields, through continuous monitoring of climatic conditions conducive to the spread of diseases...from the comfort of home •/uni00A010% of farm managers and owners are Not On Site (NOP), they need remote monitoring.

records.name: Sodishop
records.description: Sodishop is a marketplace with a mission to facilitate online buying and selling in Africa. Based in Mali, Senegal, Guinea, and Ivory Coast, Sodishop offers delivery within urban areas in less than 3 hours for its customers and helps local brands sell their products in Africa and worldwide. The particularity of our B2C & B2B Marketplace. Sodishop enables its customers to purchase items from one country and have them delivered within 24 to 48 hours to another, allowing for seamless cross-border transactions. This interconnectedness also allows thousands of local brand retailers to easily find suppliers across countries without the need for physical travel. Our team has over 15 years of experience in digital marketing, web development, sales, and marketing.

records.name: Yoonema
records.description: Yoonema is an SEO-ready platform, a digital marketplace empowering social commerce in the ECOWAS region through advanced features for social sellers. We offer a frictionless, unique and simplified experience to our users (buyers and sellers) thanks to a fully functional platform, with a beutiful design that makes it easy to use. Our customers are any e-buyer (B2C) who wants quality products, with our curated selection, and also any social e-commerce player (B2B), who wants to offer the full global e-commerce experience to his clients.

records.name: 10mg Pharma
records.description: 10mg Pharma, a recipient of numerous awards, operates an AI-driven supply chain for chronic pain medications in Africa. By cutting out supply chain intermediaries and establishing direct partnerships with manufacturers through advance financing, the startup achieves significant cost efficiencies. This approach enables up to a 23% discount on standard medication costs, boosting profit margins for healthcare providers by 3% and providing patients with savings of up to 15%. Using their innovative code tree model, 10mg Pharma is building a robust database infrastructure that eliminate financial hurdles and facilitate cross-border low-interest lending without collaterals for healthcare providers in underserved African communities.

records.name: Babimo
records.description: Babimo is a fintech in the payment industry that helps SMEs in Ivory Coast to receive digital payments and grow their turnover through value added services. The growth of e-commerce in Côte d'Ivoire has driven the demand for robust payment solutions. Businesses are increasingly integrating online payment options to cater to the preferences of consumers who prefer digital transactions. More than 300 merchants are currently using Babimo and the startup is experiencing a steady growth in turnover since inception.

records.name: BETAPAWA Solutions
records.description: Betapawa is building IoT-enabled solar-powered pods to provide sustainable energy solutions, and connectivity, and empower underserved communities. These pods will serve as a multifunctional center delivering various services, including electricity access, internet connectivity, financial services, education, and healthcare support. The Nigerian startup has served over 50 clients and signed up 100 households for their pilot pod grid. They have also identified over 50 communities for their roll-outs.

records.name: Edusko
records.description: Over one billion children will be born over the next 3 decades in sub-Saha- ran Africa. In the same vein, the rest of the world will depend on Africa for talents. Sadly, millions of African parents are unable to provide quality education for these future talents due to poor learning outcomes in the public schools while the alternative better education in the private schools are not affordable. Edusko matches African kids with the right k-12 private schools and finance their education affordably. The Nigerian startup has listed over 8,000 k-12 top rated private schools in Nigeria, generated over $400,000 in revenue with over 70% margin and was named top 50 EdTech Startup in Africa by Holon IQ in 2022

records.name: KoriTech
records.description: Kori Tech KoriPass is an innovative payment system coming out of Senegal. The fintech’s unique value proposition lies in using NFC technology to speed up transactions, handle change issues and significantly reduce waiting times in many cash heavy sectors like transportations and small retail. The product is built to scale as it does not require a smartphone or internet which is a barrier in most Francophone countries. With Koripass, payments are simple,fast and hassle-free! The company won the first prize at the Salon des Startups 4.0 Afritech Startup competition in 2022 and was among the 8 finalists of the Ecobank Fintech Challenge 2023.

records.name: LyfPlus
records.description: LyfPlus is a telemedicine, tele-diagnosis provider offering affordable and convenient medical services through it's proprietary platform working with specialist doctors and partner health facilities. The LyfPlus platform integrates virtual physician consultation, medical testing and e-prescription allowing patients to access essential medical services instantly and conveniently. LyfPlus has to date acquired a strategic partnership with the Medical Asso- ciation of Tanzania (MAT) that assures us access to over 2,000 member doctors to work with to adequately expand our other regions of the country and raised a pre-seed investment round with UNDP's Funguo Program and Serengeti Business Angels Network.

records.name: Messenger
records.description: The last mile delivery landscape in Nigeria has been dynamic, influenced by factors such as rapid urbanization, technological advancements, and the growth of e-commerce. Messenger facilitates last mile deliveries by empowering gig workers with asset financing and short-term loans thereby connecting businesses to their customers. Since inception, the Nigerian startup has created 500 jobs, fulfilled over 1 million deliveries, disbursed 1000 loans and financed over 150 bikes.

records.name: Munakyalo Agrofresh
records.description: Munakyalo Agrofresh provides solar powered cold stations to smallholder farmers in Uganda. These extend the shelf life of perishable produce from the usual 2 days to 3 weeks saving 80% food losses and giving farmers more time to search for buyers with better prices for their produce. The startup has managed to mobilize over 5000 farmers and has acquired over 3000 paying customers for their products. Munakyalo is also aggregat- ing and offtaking the fresh fruits and vegetables which inturn enables the farmers to access markets and increase their incomes.

records.name: Ostafandy
records.description: Ostafandy is an Egyptian construction-tech company that estimates, finishes, renovates, and fixes homes though their marketplace and smart quotation apps. The construction sector in North Africa has seen the emergence of software solutions tailored for project management, scheduling, and cost estimation. These technologies aim to enhance efficiency and transparency in construction projects. Ostafandy has a smart quote and algorithmic pricing engine that has catered to over 1,600 service providers in Egypt resulting in more than 5000 quotes created.

records.name: Primed E-Health
records.description: Primed E-Health has been at the forefront of digitization the health space in Nigeria. They digitize small to large scale hospitals, clinics, and specialist practices in Africa using a simple, user-friendly hospital-based enterprise management system that increases efficiency in patient management and improves revenue generation by blocking fiscal leakages in hospitals. Primed has also launched “The Smartclinic” to address persistent challenges in healthcare in relation to the authenticity of patient data [to prevent health- care fraud], paper-based record keeping [leading to pilfering and lost reve- nue], cash-based transactions and payment difficulties [leading to long queues in hospitals]. Primed E-health has successfully trained and onboarded over 10,000 doctors, and directly impacted the lives of over 2,000,000 patients in the 45 hospitals that they operate in.
